turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why is there a zero in the gradebook?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Okay. Report card week doesn't explain a zero, Hale. Who decided to enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kind would have been a phone call before the gradebook. Owen found out on his phone, in the middle of class. Withdraw the zero, Hale.
